## 3. 使用方式

所有多模态模型都通过 `/chat/completions` 接口调用，使用标准化的 `messages` 格式，其中 `content` 可以包含不同类型的内容部分。

### 3.1 基本消息格式
    
    `{
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {
                "type": "text" | "image_url" | "audio_url" | "video_url",
                "[type]_url": {
                    // 对应类型的配置
                }
            }
        ]
    }`

### 3.2 通用参数说明

#### 图像参数 (`image_url`)

  * `url`: 图像 URL 或 base64 编码数据，DeepSeek-OCR 还支持 PDF URL 或 base64 编码数据
  * `detail`: 细节级别 (`auto`, `low`, `high`)

#### 视频参数 (`video_url`)

  * `url`: 视频 URL 或 base64 编码数据
  * `detail`: 细节级别 (`auto`, `low`, `high`)
  * `max_frames`: 最大提取帧数
  * `fps`: 每秒提取帧数，最终帧数为 `min(fps × T, max_frames)`

#### 音频参数 (`audio_url`)

  * `url`: 音频 URL 或 base64 编码数据

GLM 系列  | 最小 `28×28`；
按 `28` 的倍数取整到区间；
若小于 `112×112` 或超出上限则回压到区间  | 统一 `448×448`，≈`256 token`  | 长宽取最近 `28` 倍数并限制在 `(12544, 4816894)` 像素区间  | `(h/28) * (w/28)`

### 7.2 视频输入计费

视频内容根据提取的帧数转换为 tokens：

  * 最终帧数 = `min(fps × 视频时长, max_frames)`
  * 每帧图像按对应视觉模型的标准转换

### 7.3 音频输入计费

音频内容转换为 tokens 进行计费，对于 Qwen3 omni 多模态模型，输入音频每秒对应 13 个 token， 如 22.5s 音频对应 292 个 token。

L62: # Multimodal input
L63: 
L64: Multimodal models process text, image, audio, and video simultaneously for cross-modal understanding and fusion analysis.
L65: ## cite49†1. Overview L66: 
L67: Multimodal models are large language models capable of processing multiple types of information (text, images, audio, video) simultaneously. SiliconFlow provides several powerful models supporting different modality combinations that can:
L68:   1. Visual Understanding: Understand image content, OCR, image description
L69:   2. Video Analysis: Extract video frames, understand video content, action recognition
L70:   3. Audio Processing: Speech recognition, audio content analysis
L71:   4. Multimodal Fusion: Comprehensive analysis of multiple media types simultaneously
L72: ## cite50†2. Supported Models Overview L73: Model Series  | Vision  | Audio  | Video  | Key Features
L74: --- | --- | --- | --- | ---
L75: Qwen3-Omni Series  | ✅  | ✅  | ✅  | Full multimodal support, simultaneous audio/video processing
L76: Qwen3-VL Series  | ✅  | ❌  | ✅  | Visual+video understanding, no audio support
L77: GLM Series  | ✅  | ❌  | ❌  | Vision understanding only
L78: Qwen2-VL Series  | ✅  | ❌  | ❌  | Vision understanding only
L79: DeepseekVL2 Series  | ✅  | ❌  | ❌  | Vision understanding only
L80: Step3  | ✅  | ❌  | ❌  | Vision understanding only
L81: View the current list of supported multimodal models in the cite51†Model Hub†cloud.siliconflow.cn . Supported models may be adjusted, please refer to the actual platform display.
L82: ## cite52†3. Usage Methods L83: 
L84: All multimodal models are called through the `/chat/completions` interface using a standardized `messages` format, where `content` can contain different types of content parts.
